summary.architectural_limitation_statement: Category C features represent kernel/packet-level network metrics (e.g. spkts, dpkts, sttl, tcprtt, jitter, window advertisement). Because our architecture operates at the application stream socket layer (SOCK_STREAM) without packet sniffing, these features cannot be legitimately observed. In accordance with strict cybersecurity integrity rules, fabrication of missing features is prohibited. The live bridge explicitly identifies this boundary.

proto.derivation: Directly observed from the active socket protocol (always 'tcp').

service.definition: Application service protocol (e.g. http, ftp, smtp, -).
service.derivation: Observed from application message headers ('-' for custom TCP protocol).

state.definition: State of transaction / connection (e.g. CON, FIN, REQ, INT).
state.derivation: Directly observed: 'CON' while connected, 'FIN' on graceful close.

dur.definition: Record total flow duration in seconds.
dur.measurement_point: Connection lifecycle timer (perf_counter() at connect vs disconnect).

sbytes.derivation: Directly observed: sum of all bytes received from client socket.

dbytes.derivation: Directly observed: sum of all bytes sent by server in responses.

spkts.definition: Source to destination IP packet count.
spkts.reason_unavailable: Application-layer TCP sockets (SOCK_STREAM) provide a byte stream; individual IP packets and TCP segments are handled internally by the OS kernel network stack.

dpkts.definition: Destination to source IP packet count.
dpkts.reason_unavailable: TCP ACK and response segment packetization is handled asynchronously by the kernel network stack; not visible at application socket level.

rate.definition: Total packets per second: (spkts + dpkts) / dur.
rate.reason_unavailable: In UNSW-NB15, 'rate' is specifically IP packet rate, NOT application request rate. Depends on spkts and dpkts.

sttl.definition: Source to destination time to live.
sttl.reason_unavailable: IPv4 TTL header field is stripped by OS TCP stack and not exposed by default in standard Python socket read.

dttl.definition: Destination to source time to live.
dttl.reason_unavailable: Generated by host kernel IP stack on outbound packets; not captured by application layer socket.

sload.measurement_point: Flow arithmetic from observable sbytes and dur.

dload.measurement_point: Flow arithmetic from observable dbytes and dur.

sloss.reason_unavailable: TCP loss recovery and retransmissions are hidden by the reliable transport abstraction.

dloss.reason_unavailable: TCP outbound loss recovery is hidden inside kernel.

sinpkt.definition: Source inter-packet arrival time in milliseconds.
sinpkt.reason_unavailable: Requires per-packet NIC arrival timestamps; socket API coalesces segments into stream buffer.

dinpkt.definition: Destination inter-packet arrival time in milliseconds.
dinpkt.reason_unavailable: Requires per-packet departure timestamps; not observable at application stream level.

sjit.measurement_point: Statistical analysis of packet inter-arrival times.
sjit.reason_unavailable: Depends on per-packet sinpkt arrival intervals.

djit.measurement_point: Statistical analysis of packet inter-departure times.
djit.reason_unavailable: Depends on per-packet dinpkt departure intervals.

swin.reason_unavailable: 16-bit TCP header window advertisement is managed and consumed by OS TCP stack.

stcpb.reason_unavailable: 32-bit TCP sequence numbers are managed by kernel transport layer.

dtcpb.reason_unavailable: 32-bit TCP sequence numbers are managed by kernel transport layer.

dwin.reason_unavailable: TCP window advertisement in outbound segments is managed by OS kernel.

tcprtt.definition: TCP round trip time (SYN to SYN_ACK in seconds).
tcprtt.reason_unavailable: Handshake completes in kernel before accept() returns the socket to application.

synack.reason_unavailable: Kernel TCP handshake timing is not accessible via standard socket API.

ackdat.reason_unavailable: Kernel TCP handshake timing is not accessible via standard socket API.

smean.definition: Mean packet size transmitted by source.
smean.reason_unavailable: In UNSW-NB15, smean is average IP packet size, NOT application request size. Depends on spkts.

dmean.definition: Mean packet size transmitted by destination.

trans_depth.derivation: In our synchronous request-response protocol, trans_depth is 1.

response_body_len.definition: Actual payload content size transferred from server response.
response_body_len.derivation: Sum of UTF-8 application payload lengths returned by the server.

ct_srv_src.definition: Number of connections to same service from source IP in 100 connection window.
ct_srv_src.derivation: Tracked in rolling 100-connection history by client IP and service.

ct_state_ttl.definition: Count of connections having same state and TTL.
ct_state_ttl.reason_unavailable: Requires TTL which is unobservable at application layer.

ct_dst_ltm.definition: Number of connections to destination in 100 connection window.
ct_dst_ltm.derivation: Tracked in rolling 100-connection history for server.

ct_src_dport_ltm.definition: Connections from source IP to destination port in 100 connection window.
ct_src_dport_ltm.derivation: Tracked in rolling 100-connection history for client IP to server port.

ct_dst_sport_ltm.definition: Connections to destination IP from source port in 100 connection window.
ct_dst_sport_ltm.derivation: Tracked in rolling 100-connection history for client ephemeral port.

ct_dst_src_ltm.definition: Connections between source and destination IP in 100 connection window.
ct_dst_src_ltm.derivation: Tracked in rolling 100-connection history for client IP to server IP.

is_ftp_login.definition: 1 if FTP session logged in, 0 otherwise.
is_ftp_login.derivation: Always 0 for non-FTP custom TCP protocol.

ct_ftp_cmd.definition: Count of FTP commands in session.
ct_ftp_cmd.derivation: Always 0 for non-FTP custom TCP protocol.

ct_flw_http_mthd.definition: Count of HTTP methods (GET/POST) in session.
ct_flw_http_mthd.derivation: Count of HTTP-like request commands (0 for standard custom TCP).

ct_src_ltm.definition: Connections from source IP in 100 connection window.
ct_src_ltm.derivation: Tracked in rolling 100-connection history for client IP.

ct_srv_dst.definition: Connections to service from destination in 100 connection window.
ct_srv_dst.derivation: Tracked in rolling 100-connection history for server service.

is_sm_ips_ports.definition: 1 if source and destination IP and ports are equal, 0 otherwise.
is_sm_ips_ports.derivation: 1 if (client_ip == server_ip and client_port == server_port) else 0.
